style_settings.name: aggressive
style_settings.raw_preference: opponent bar increase during the candidate action
style_settings.normalization: min-max over distinct candidate outcomes; zero if equal
style_settings.scope: candidate score only; cutoff and rollout policy shared

notes: Independent game seeds; alternating MC seats; standard opening contest.
Heuristic opponent uses the same cutoff evaluator at depth zero, with unique resulting positions and random tie breaking.
Timing covers MC choose_move, including forced passes, excluding validation.
Wilson interval treats game outcomes as independent; pilot evidence only.
Rollout policy applies to both simulated players; heuristic weights remain fixed.
This evaluates current fixed heuristic weights, not their optimality.
